about: Which crop of the client's window identifies each screen, and where each press lands, both measured in
window coordinates at the size the key names. The crops themselves are pictures of the client, so they
are never committed: 'drive.py capture-refs' rebuilds them from a live client into the Ambrose data
folder, and a run refuses to judge a screen whose crop is missing or was measured on another revision.
The interface scale is whatever the install's own configuration carries, because the launcher changes
only the window mode, the window size and the metrics address; a changed scale invalidates every number
here and the crops with it.
'never_quit_after' holds the one thing this client does that reaches off the machine: what it must not
have last written in its own log when the driver asks it to quit, and what puts it right again.

login.shows: the two buttons under the login window's password field

invalid.shows: the two buttons of the dialog the client shows when a login is refused

charselect.shows: the row of buttons along the bottom of the character selection screen

dialog_next.shows: the button that moves a creation dialogue on, on the right of its bar

dialog_back.shows: the button that moves a creation dialogue back, on the left of its bar

test_book.shows: the button that skips the sorting test

school_list.shows: the heading over the list of schools

school_chosen.shows: the button that confirms the school chosen

appearance.shows: the button that accepts the wizard's look

name.shows: the two buttons of the naming screen

never_quit_after.undone_by: The LoginServer has admitted the user
never_quit_after.because: a client that has been refused a login opens a page of KingsIsle's in the machine's own browser the moment it is asked to quit, and no setting the launcher writes stops it; taking it off the dialog does not help, because the state outlasts the dialog and outlasts the login window coming back, so a client still in that state is ended instead of being asked to quit

login_reconnect.presses: the button of the refused-login dialog that reconnects

charselect_new.presses: the button of the character selection screen that starts a new wizard

dialog_next.presses: the button that moves a creation dialogue on

test_skip.presses: the button that skips the sorting test

school_ice.presses: the fourth school in the list

school_ok.presses: the button that confirms the school chosen

preset_next.presses: the arrow that takes the next ready-made look

appearance_next.presses: the button that accepts the wizard's look

name_random.presses: the button that rolls a name

name_done.presses: the button that submits the wizard
